title: a11ydump: queue dumps of one phone behind a host lock
objective: Concurrent android_ui --display calls from different sessions never crash each other's instrumentation.
acceptance_criteria: install + am instrument run under a per-serial flock
a 300 s live run with two fake sessions has 0 failed taps/dumps
verifier: Live two-session run on the Pixel 6a; pytest python_pkg/android_ui at 100% branch coverage.
